tasks.spec:
You are a READ-ONLY diagnosis scout for the OBE podcast repo at /mnt/d_drive/repos/podcast. You may run pytest and git commands against that repo and read any file, but you must NOT modify, create, or delete anything inside it. Your only writable output is ./report.md in your current scratch task directory. Do not load skills or call MCP/Apps. No network access.

CONTEXT: these 11 tests fail on podcast master today AND failed at commit 79823f8 (before a recent hardening branch), so they are pre-existing. The owner wants them cleaned up properly — which requires knowing, per test, whether the TEST is stale or the PRODUCTION CODE is broken. Do not guess: run them, read the tracebacks, read the code under test, and use git log/blame to find when and why each started diverging.

THE 11 TESTS:
tests/test_orchestrator.py::test_publish_interpolates_episode_link_in_social_posts
tests/test_orchestrator.py::test_publish_social_posts_include_clip
tests/test_publishing.py::test_handle_publish_gateway_lease_active_at_provider_seams
tests/test_publishing.py::test_handle_publish_routes_real_provider_calls_through_gateway
tests/test_publishing.py::test_handle_publish_transistor_replay_requires_provider_id_and_never_resends
tests/test_publishing.py::test_publish_social_dispatch_replay_allows_downstream_state
tests/test_publishing.py::test_publish_social_gated_outcome_does_not_write_state_or_advance[blocked]
tests/test_publishing.py::test_publish_social_gated_outcome_does_not_write_state_or_advance[failed]
tests/test_publishing.py::test_publish_social_gated_outcome_does_not_write_state_or_advance[shadow]
tests/test_publishing.py::test_set_episode_image_patches_image_url
tests/test_youtube.py::test_upload_real

HOW TO RUN: cd /mnt/d_drive/repos/podcast && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest <the 11 ids> -q -p no:cacheprovider (they complete in seconds). Use PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/tmp to avoid writing bytecode into the repo. Group failures that share one root cause.

FOR EACH TEST produce in ./report.md exactly this block:
### <full test id>
VERDICT: PROD_BUG | STALE_TEST | ENV_DEPENDENT | FLAKY
ROOT CAUSE: one or two sentences naming the exact divergence, with file:line of both the test expectation and the production behavior.
SINCE: the commit (hash + date + subject, via git log/blame) that introduced the divergence, or 'unknown' with what you checked.
SAFETY NOTE: does the failure hide a REAL production defect in the publish/social/gateway path (the highest-blast-radius lane of this repo)? yes/no + why.
RECOMMENDED FIX: the minimal correct fix — for STALE_TEST say exactly what the test should assert now and why that is the CORRECT current contract (cite the commit that legitimately changed behavior); for PROD_BUG say what the code should do and why the test encodes the right contract; for ENV_DEPENDENT say what to mock/inject (never blanket-skip without a documented reason and a skipif condition that is honest).

End the report with:
## Summary table
| test | verdict | shared root cause group | fix target file(s) |
plus a '## Fix plan' section proposing how to partition the fixes into 1-3 disjoint-ownership fix tasks (name exact files each would own).

HARD RULES: never modify the repo; base every claim on an executed command or a read file (quote the key traceback line); if two tests fail for one shared cause, say so explicitly; if you cannot determine SINCE, say what you tried. OUTPUT CONTRACT: ./report.md as specified — it is the entire deliverable.
tasks.check: python3 -c "import re,sys; t=open('report.md').read(); ids=['test_publish_interpolates_episode_link_in_social_posts','test_publish_social_posts_include_clip','test_handle_publish_gateway_lease_active_at_provider_seams','test_handle_publish_routes_real_provider_calls_through_gateway','test_handle_publish_transistor_replay_requires_provider_id_and_never_resends','test_publish_social_dispatch_replay_allows_downstream_state','test_publish_social_gated_outcome_does_not_write_state_or_advance','test_set_episode_image_patches_image_url','test_upload_real']; missing=[i for i in ids if i not in t]; v=len(re.findall(r'^VERDICT: (PROD_BUG|STALE_TEST|ENV_DEPENDENT|FLAKY)', t, re.M)); rc=len(re.findall(r'^ROOT CAUSE:', t, re.M)); fixplan='Fix plan' in t or 'fix plan' in t.lower(); print(f'missing={missing} verdicts={v} rootcauses={rc} fixplan={fixplan}'); sys.exit(0 if not missing and v>=9 and rc>=9 and fixplan else 1)"
tasks.verified: report.md covers all 11 tests with a verdict, root cause, and fix plan; validator counts every required section
